svg.title: The cache layers of Next.js in the previous model and with Cache Components
svg.desc: Two stacks of layers between the browser and the data source. Previous model: browser HTTP cache and CDN, client router cache, Full Route Cache, Data Cache for fetch and unstable_cache, request memoization. Cache Components: browser HTTP cache and CDN, client cache, prerendered shells and route entries, use cache entries in a cache handler (in memory by default, shared with use cache remote), the fetch Data Cache that still works, request memoization. Use cache private results live only in the browser.
svg.text: The cache layers of Next.js, per model
a request travels down and stops at the first layer that holds a fresh answer
Previous model
cacheComponents: false (the default)
1. Browser HTTP cache and CDN (outside Next.js)
Static and ISR pages: s-maxage and stale-while-revalidate
Dynamic pages: private, no-cache, no-store
2. Client router cache
In the tab: RSC payloads of layouts, loading UI and pages
Dynamic page segment: 0 s since 15; static: 300 s
Tuned with staleTimes; cleared by revalidating Server Actions
3. Full Route Cache
Server: HTML and RSC payload of every prerendered route
Set by the dynamic, revalidate and fetchCache segment config
Invalidated by revalidatePath or a tag; rebuilt on next request
4. Data Cache
Server: fetch with cache: 'force-cache', next.revalidate, next.tags
and unstable_cache(fn, keyParts, { tags, revalidate })
Survives deployments; revalidateTag and updateTag act on it
5. Request memoization
One render pass: identical GET fetch calls and React cache()
Nothing persists after the response is sent
Data source: database, CMS, REST or GraphQL API
Cache Components
cacheComponents: true (opt-in)
1. Browser HTTP cache and CDN (outside Next.js)
Fully prerendered pages: s-maxage and swr from cacheLife
Streamed (PPR) responses: private, no-cache, no-store
2. Client cache
In the tab; lifetime is cacheLife stale (minimum 30 s)
Sent as x-nextjs-stale-time; cleared by revalidating actions
'use cache: private' results live only here
3. Prerendered shells and route entries
Server or CDN: static shell HTML and RSC payload, ISR entries
revalidate and expire come from cacheLife; PPR streams holes
Replaces the dynamic, revalidate and fetchCache segment config
4. 'use cache' entries in a cache handler
Key: build id + function id + serialized arguments; cacheTag
default handler: in-memory LRU, one per server instance;
'use cache: remote': a shared store set in cacheHandlers
Entries do not survive a deployment
4b. Data Cache (unchanged, a separate layer)
fetch force-cache and unstable_cache still work, survive deploys
5. Request memoization
Same as before; React cache() is isolated per cached function
Data source: database, CMS, REST or GraphQL API
Dashed border: not owned by Next.js, steered only through response headers.
